source.author: ov
source.text: Quae gemitus truncaeque deo Neptunius heros causa rogat frontis, cum sic Calydonius amnis coepit inornatos redimitus harundine crines:
source.text_original: Quae gemitus truncaeque deo Neptunius heros / causa rogat frontis, cum sic Calydonius amnis / coepit inornatos redimitus harundine crines:
source.text_english: What cause of groans and of her torn-off forehead the Neptunian hero asks of the god, when the Calydonian river began thus, its unadorned hair bound with reeds:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: subita cur pulcher harundine crines velat Hylas?
reuse.text_original: subita cur pulcher harundine crines / velat Hylas?
reuse.text_english: Why does beautiful Hylas suddenly veil his hair with a reed?
